title: Triple Coil Wrap Bangle
category: Bracelet (flexible 2-turn snake-coil wrap bangle with 2 pavé end caps, sold as 1 piece)
metal: Two variants: 18k gold tone (PVD 18K gold coating) or rhodium silver tone (PVD rhodium coating), both over surgical stainless steel. High-polish ribbed wire, mirror-polished caps.
turnCount: RESOLVED: 2 full turns. Every listing photo that shows the piece (01-06, 08) has 2 wires at the back and sides. The only 3-wire stack is the short span between the 2 offset caps at the front, where the ends pass each other. The description agrees ('Two turns', 'wound twice', 8 mm across two turns = 2 x 4 mm wire, 12 mm at the overlap = 3 x 4 mm). The 'Triple' in the title, the supplier PI's 'Three-layer coil' and the ads-500 note that the gallery 'shows THREE turns' all count those 3 wires at the overlap. They are not 3 turns. The ads-500 refs are these same photos (mean pixel difference about 1.5/255).
lock: 1 continuous ribbed snake-coil (tubogas) wire, 4 mm thick, wound 2 full turns, 6 cm inside. The 2 ends pass at the front, so only there the stack is 3 wires deep (12 mm); elsewhere 2 (8 mm). Each end: 1 rectangular cap, 8 mm tall, rounded tip, 8 clear round pavé stones in 2 columns of 4; upper cap ends the top turn, lower cap the bottom, offset diagonally. 18k gold tone or rhodium silver tone, high polish. Must stay 2 full turns with a short 3-wire overlap only between the caps, never 3 full coils or a stack of separate bangles.
morph: The turn count at the overlap. Image models (and two earlier readers) take the 3-wire stack between the caps as a third full coil and draw 3 complete turns. They also split the wrap into 2-3 separate closed bangles, line the caps up side by side or move them to the middle of a turn, or turn the 2x4 pavé into a single row or a solid pavé band. Secondary drift: the deep ribbing gets smoothed into a plain tube or twisted rope.
sizeMm: Inside 6 cm (60 mm) across, give or take 1 mm (description and size-guide photo 08). Wire 4 mm (size guide). Cap about 8 mm tall (size-guide bracket), about 5 mm long (estimated from macro 02). Height 8 mm across the 2 turns, 12 mm where the ends overlap (description). Body referent, estimated from worn photos 03 and 06: it sits snug just above the wrist bone, the 2-wire band about as tall as a pencil is thick. 6 cm inside is about an Indian bangle size 2.6, but the wrap flexes over the hand.
mediaIdSource: Ref 1 (01 gold packshot) reuses the ads-500 'gold' id from ads-500/build/refs.json and products.md. 01.jpg is the same photo as ads-500/build/refs/triple-coil-wrap-bangle__gold.jpg (same size, mean pixel difference about 1.5/255). Ref 2 (03 gold worn) had no earlier id and was imported to Higgsfield from its Shopify CDN URL on 2026-11-20. Ref 2 is the worn photo, not the macro (ads-500 gold-macro b429323d-a6fd-43b0-8f84-553eb997787f), on purpose: the macro crops off the back of the wrap and puts the 3-wire overlap in the centre, which is what got misread as 3 turns. The worn photo shows both turns, both caps and the true scale on a wrist.
variants: Gold (18k gold tone) stock 20, Silver (rhodium silver tone) stock 19, both Rs 1,149. Show Gold: its photos are the best (01 packshot, 02 macro, 03 and 04 worn, 08 size guide). For Silver, use 06 (silver worn, clean). Silver packshot 05 is soft and over-sharpened, and its pavé reads as smeared grey scribbles, so do not use it as a reference. A two-metal line-up is possible, but each tone needs its own clean source.
story: A bangle stack in one piece. The 2 glossy ribbed turns read like 2 slim bangles worn together, and the 2 pavé caps crossing at the front are the only sparkle. There is no clasp: the coil flexes over the hand and wraps back. It rhymes with the Indian habit of stacking bangles, cut down to one clean line, and with the gas-pipe snake-coil jewellery of the 70s and 80s. The listing styles it with a mustard satin slip and a bare wrist ('Wear it alone. It already looks like a stack.'). Waterproof, so it is a day-to-night, never-take-it-off piece.
copyNotes: Use: two turns, wraps the wrist twice, 'looks like a stack, goes on as one', flexible wrap, ribbed snake coil, pavé end caps, clear cubic zirconia, 18k gold tone, rhodium silver tone, PVD, surgical stainless steel, waterproof, tarnish free, hypoallergenic, 6 cm inside. Avoid: 'triple', 'three turns', 'three coils' or 'three-layer' in body copy (the product name may appear only as its name, and the owner may want to rename it, because the piece has 2 turns); 'adjustable' (not on the listing); 'cuff'; 'spring' or 'memory wire'; 'gold' or 'silver' without 'tone'; 'solid gold'; 'sterling'; 'diamond' or 'crystal' (say cubic zirconia or pavé); 'anti-tarnish' (say tarnish free); 'one size fits all'; designer or brand names for the snake-coil style.

Macro of the front overlap: both caps (8 stones each, 2 columns of 4), the middle wire passing between them, deep ribbing; the back of the wrap is out of focus. Best stone-count detail, but it frames only the 3-wire overlap, which is what got misread as 3 turns. Same photo as the ads-500 gold-macro ref.
Worn on the left wrist, hand at the collarbone, mustard satin slip. 2 turns and both offset caps clear; true scale on the wrist. Reference 2.
Wider worn shot: model in a mustard satin slip dress, hand at the throat, bangle small in frame. Styling and outfit reference; too small for construction.

Silver packshot on a plaster block, same set-up as 01. 2 turns and 2 caps, but the image is soft and over-sharpened and the pavé reads as smeared grey scribbles. Do not use as a reference. Same photo as the ads-500 silver ref (03d826e6-69b9-48f5-9afa-44b5011b3ab8).
Worn on the wrist with a mustard satin slip. Clean rhodium silver tone; 2 turns and both pavé caps visible. Best silver photo if a silver reference is needed (no media id yet).
Packaging: blush NAIRA box on sheer organza. No product.

Size guide: supplier photo of the gold piece with bars for 6 cm inside, 4 mm wire and 8 mm cap; headline 'TRIPLE COIL WRAP BANGLE'; text '6 cm across inside'. Scale evidence; has a text overlay, so it is not a generation reference. It also shows 2 turns.
